title: One-Two Step Shooting
description: Shooters catch on the move and step into the shot inside foot first, then outside foot (1-2), turning the body square to the rim in rhythm.

content.objective: Use a rhythmic 1-2 step on the catch so the shot comes out square and on balance.
content.setup: Passer at the top; shooters line up at the wing and move toward the elbow.
content.organization: Shooter becomes passer; passer rebounds and joins the line.
instructions: The shooter jogs from the wing toward the elbow, hands ready.
Catch in the air and land on the inside foot (the foot nearer the rim) first.
Step the outside foot down, turning the hips square to the rim.
Shoot in one motion from the 1-2 landing.
coachingPoints: Inside foot first: it turns the body to the rim.
commonMistakes: Stepping with the outside foot first and shooting across the body.
Catching low and bringing the ball up late.
content.safety: Shooters rebound their own ball only when the lane is clear; nobody stands under the rim while others shoot.
progressions: Come off a cone 'screen' at speed.
regressions: Walk the footwork without a ball.
Catch from a stationary position, then 1-2.
variations: Use the hop (both feet) and compare.
content.gameApplication: Shooters coming off cuts and screens use the 1-2 step to shoot quickly and square.
